diagnostic_evidence.quote: Notice that we can decompose the error into a component arising from the fixed point iterations and another due to the neural network approximation by writing $\left\|\tilde{u}_n - u \right\|_{\Omega} \leq \left\|\tilde{u}_n - u_n \right\|_{\Omega} + \left\|u_n - u \right\|_{\Omega}$. Substituting the error bound (\ref{error-domain}) and using the known error bound for the fixed point iterations results in (\ref{error-recurrent}).

issues.failure_explanation: In Lemma 4.1, the proof bounds the error between the computed iterate \tilde{u}_n and the exact iterate u_n by asserting \|\tilde{u}_n - u_n\|_\Omega \le \epsilon_\Omega^{RPFNN}. However, in Algorithm 1, each step k computes \tilde{u}_k by applying the PFNN to the PDE whose source term is built from \tilde{u}_{k-1}, not from the exact iterate u_{k-1}. Since the operator T is a q-contraction, the actual error satisfies the recurrence \|\tilde{u}_k - u_k\|_\Omega \le q\|\tilde{u}_{k-1} - u_{k-1}\|_\Omega + e_k with \|e_k\|_\Omega \le \epsilon_\Omega^{RPFNN}. Unrolling this inexact fixed-point recurrence yields \|\tilde{u}_n - u_n\|_\Omega \le \frac{1-q^n}{1-q}\epsilon_\Omega^{RPFNN}. The factor \frac{1-q^n}{1-q} (which approaches \frac{1}{1-q} > 1) is completely omitted from (46), making the claimed bound false whenever n \ge 2. Furthermore, for the boundary condition, the exact iterates satisfy u_n = f on \partial \Omega identically for all n \ge 1, so the term q^n \|u_0 - u\|_{\partial \Omega} is ungrounded.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Analyze the error as an inexact contraction mapping iteration, replacing \epsilon_\Omega^{RPFNN} in (46) with \frac{1-q^n}{1-q}\epsilon_\Omega^{RPFNN}, and removing the contraction term q^n \|u_0 - u\|_{\partial \Omega} from the boundary bound.
issues.overall_effect: The error bound (46) in Lemma 4.1 for the Recurrent PFNN approximation is mathematically invalid and underestimates the actual numerical error by omitting the error accumulation factor across iterations.
issues.title: Omission of error accumulation factor in recurrent PFNN error bound
issues.why_classification: The issue requires replacing the proof step with a standard inexact fixed-point error accumulation argument and adjusting the bound by the factor (1 - q^n)/(1 - q). This is a contained nontrivial repair that leaves a recognizably comparable convergence guarantee without altering the global proof architecture.
